title: Production-Control Implementation
description: Implement and validate the seven Sprint 35 production-control contracts against the human-authorized hosted architecture using production-equivalent hosted controls under governed $0 free-tier constraints, with independent validation evidence and no architecture-authority drift.
acceptance_criteria: Cloud IAM is validated with least-privilege and denial evidence in production-equivalent hosted free-tier execution
Production identity federation is validated with forged, expired, revoked, and wrong-audience denial paths
Managed database row-level isolation and network boundaries are validated in production-equivalent hosted execution
Per-tenant key management and secrets handling are validated for rotation, revocation, and leakage resistance
Real customer data, production credentials, and secret plaintext are prohibited from all validation runs and artifacts
Independent validation is executed by an authorized reviewer who is not the control implementer
Independent penetration testing evidence is produced using governed zero-cost tooling plus manual abuse-case execution

evidence.description: Sprint 45 execution gate language for production-equivalent hosted controls under governed $0 free-tier constraints.
Actionable control checklist and validation rubric for all seven production controls.
Independent validation protocol defining reviewer role separation and zero-cost execution path.
Credential-bound handoff checklist with exact commands, expected outputs, and acceptance thresholds.
Consolidated release gate checklist, known risks, mitigations, go/no-go criteria, and minimal human actions.
Machine-checkable control acceptance gates preserving fail-closed PARTIAL behavior until independent PASS attestations.
Seven control evidence records generated from the Sprint 45 schema/template with immutable artifact hashes and independent reviewer fields.
